info.name: StockAgent — Agentic Commerce for FMCG
info.description:
Full API collection for StockAgent by Diron Technologies.

**API Server** (localhost:3000): Express + SQLite backend with AI-powered supply chain agents.
**MCP Server** (localhost:3001): PayPal API wrapper (Payouts + Invoicing) using Model Context Protocol.

Set `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` for real AI mode, or leave blank for rule-based mock.
Set `PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID` / `PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET` for live PayPal sandbox, or leave blank for mock mode.

item.name: Products
item.description: Inventory management — list products, dispatch stock

request.description: Returns all products sorted by stock-to-threshold ratio (most critical first). Each product includes current_stock, reorder_threshold, and preferred supplier.

Dispatch stock of a product. Reduces current_stock and creates a dispatch record.

If stock drops below reorder_threshold, an AI agent scan is auto-triggered to create reorder cycles.

item.name: Recipients
item.description: Manage dukas, supermarkets, schools, and wholesale outlets

request.description: Returns all active recipients with dispatch stats, top product, and unpaid invoice totals.
Full recipient profile with recent dispatches, invoices, and summary stats.
Add a new recipient. Types: duka, supermarket, school, wholesale. Payment terms: cash, net-7, net-14, net-30.

item.name: Invoices
item.description: Generate, view, and send invoices via PayPal

request.description: Returns all invoices with recipient name, type, status (unpaid/paid), and totals in KES.
Full invoice with line items (product, SKU, quantity, unit price, total) and recipient contact details.
Generate an invoice for all unbilled dispatches to recipient ID 1 (Westlands Supermarket). Due date calculated from recipient's payment terms.
Mark an invoice as paid. Sets status to 'paid' and records paid_at timestamp.
Send an invoice to the recipient via PayPal Invoicing API (POST /v2/invoicing/invoices + /send). Converts KES amounts to USD at rate 130. Returns PayPal invoice ID and sandbox view URL.
Download a professional PDF invoice generated with PDFKit. Includes company branding, line items, totals, and payment terms.

item.name: Reorder Cycles
item.description: AI-created reorder cycles — approve to trigger PayPal payouts

request.description: Returns all reorder cycles with product, supplier, quantity, total KES, status (pending/paid), and PayPal transaction ID.
Approve a pending reorder cycle. Triggers a PayPal Payout (POST /v1/payments/payouts) to the supplier's email. On success: cycle marked 'paid', stock restocked, PayPal batch ID recorded.

item.name: AI Agent
item.description: AI-powered supply chain analysis and autonomous operations

request.description:
Trigger the primary AI agent. Uses Claude Haiku 5.5 (or rule-based mock if no API key).

The agent:
1. Gathers inventory snapshot (products, suppliers, pending cycles, 7-day dispatch velocity)
2. Analyzes stock levels vs thresholds
3. Recommends reorder actions with reasoning
4. Checks compliance (no duplicate pending orders)
5. Creates reorder cycles for approved recommendations

Returns: analysis, recommendations, created cycles, skipped items, and AI mode (ai/mock).
Returns timestamped agent activity logs. Each entry has: step (scan_start, ai_call, cycle_created, compliance_skip, etc.), message, and optional JSON data.

Execute a full autonomous commerce cycle in one call:

1. Dispatch enough stock to trigger a critical level
2. AI agent scans and creates reorder cycle
3. Auto-approve cycle → PayPal Payout to supplier
4. Stock restocked
5. Invoice generated for the dispatch recipient

Returns step-by-step results with PayPal batch IDs and invoice numbers.

item.name: Analytics
item.description: Recipient stocking analytics and dispatch summaries

request.description: Returns dispatch analytics per recipient: dispatch count, total KES, total units, first/last dispatch dates. Sorted by total value descending.
Returns API status, database type (sqlite), AI mode (claude/mock), model name, and timestamp.

item.name: MCP PayPal
item.description: MCP Server — PayPal API wrapper for AI agent tool use

request.description: MCP Server health check. Returns mode (MOCK/LIVE/sandbox) and available tools list.
List all MCP tools available for AI agent use: send_payout, create_invoice, send_invoice, invoice_status, transaction_status, transactions.

Send a PayPal Payout to a supplier. Wraps POST /v1/payments/payouts.

In MOCK mode: returns fake batch ID. In LIVE/sandbox mode: authenticates with PayPal OAuth2 and sends a real payout.

Create and auto-send a PayPal Invoice. Wraps POST /v2/invoicing/invoices + POST /v2/invoicing/invoices/{id}/send.

In MOCK mode: returns fake invoice ID with sandbox view URL. In LIVE mode: creates and sends a real PayPal invoice.
Send an existing draft invoice by ID. Wraps POST /v2/invoicing/invoices/{id}/send.
Check the payment status of a PayPal invoice.
Check the status of a PayPal payout batch. Wraps GET /v1/payments/payouts/{batch_id}.
List all PayPal transactions (payouts and invoices) processed through the MCP server. Includes type, ID, recipient, amount, status, and timestamp.
